system.story: The crew's lifeline - the party's missing medic, and the calling Vessa answers.

description.value:
Subclass: Shepherd. You are the crew's lifeline - the most support-tilted of the three ministries. Bonus to healing and warding: stronger Recovery-granting, more temporary Stamina, better status removal and surges.

Identity Feature - Healer's Rider

Your heals also grant a small rider: a surge, or a save against an ongoing effect. Lay On Hands, My Life For Yours, and any other healing you grant carry this rider automatically.

Signature Pact-Summon

Your Invoke the Pact calls a guardian/warding spirit - protective, and it sticks close to allies rather than pressing the attack.

Bonus Skill

A free pick by subclass flavor: Medicine (a medicine/first-aid skill for the Shepherd, per the class's key-skills rule).

Corp Records

Pastoral-care specialist.
